versos.hebraico: וַיִּוָּעַ֣ץ דָּוִ֗יד עִם־שָׂרֵ֧י הָאֲלָפִ֛ים וְהַמֵּא֖וֹת לְכָל־נָגִֽיד׃

controles.web: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.
controles.kjv: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.
controles.livre: Então Davi teve conselho com os capitães de milhares e de centenas, e com todos os chefes.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד לְכֹ֣ל׀ קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אִם־עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם ט֜וֹב וּמִן־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ נִפְרְצָה֙ נִשְׁלְחָ֞ה עַל־אַחֵ֣ינוּ הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֗ים בְּכֹל֙ אַרְצ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעִמָּהֶ֛ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּעָרֵ֣י מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם וְיִקָּבְצ֖וּ אֵלֵֽינוּ׃

controles.web: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of Yahweh our God, let us send abroad everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have suburbs, that they may gather themselves to us;
controles.kjv: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the Lord our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:
controles.livre: E Davi disse a todo a congregação de Israel: Se bem vos parece, e se vem do SENHOR nosso Deus, enviemos depressa mensageiros aos nossos irmãos que restaram em todas as terras de Israel, aos sacerdotes e aos levitas que estão com eles em suas cidades e em seus arredores, para que se ajuntem conosco.

versos.hebraico: וְנָסֵ֛בָּה אֶת־אֲר֥וֹן אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ אֵלֵ֑ינוּ כִּי־לֹ֥א דְרַשְׁנֻ֖הוּ בִּימֵ֥י שָׁאֽוּל׃

controles.web: and let us bring again the ark of our God to us. For we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”
controles.kjv: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.
controles.livre: E tragamos de volta a nós a arca de nosso Deus, porque não a buscamos desde o tempo de Saul.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ כָֽל־הַקָּהָ֖ל לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֑ן כִּֽי־יָשַׁ֥ר הַדָּבָ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י כָל־הָעָֽם׃

controles.web: All the assembly said that they would do so; for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
controles.kjv: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
controles.livre: Então toda a congregação disse que assim se fizesse, porque isso pareceu correto aos olhos de todo o povo.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּקְהֵ֤ל דָּוִיד֙ אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִן־שִׁיח֥וֹר מִצְרַ֖יִם וְעַד־לְב֣וֹא חֲמָ֑ת לְהָבִיא֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מִקִּרְיַ֖ת יְעָרִֽים׃

controles.web: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor the brook of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath Jearim.
controles.kjv: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath–jearim.
controles.livre: Assim Davi ajuntou a todo Israel, desde Sior do Egito, até chegar a Hamate, para que trouxessem a arca de Deus de Quriate-Jearim.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨עַל דָּוִ֤יד וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בַּעֲלָ֔תָה אֶל־קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִיהוּדָ֑ה לְהַעֲל֣וֹת מִשָּׁ֗ם אֵת֩ אֲר֨וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֧ים׀ יְהוָ֛ה יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הַכְּרוּבִ֖ים אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שֵֽׁם׃

controles.web: David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God Yahweh that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.
controles.kjv: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjath–jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the Lord, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.
controles.livre: Então Davi subiu com todo Israel a Baalá, que é Quriate-Jearim, em Judá, para dali trazerem acima a arca de Deus, o SENHOR, que habita entre os querubins, a qual é chamada pelo seu nome.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּרְכִּ֜יבוּ אֶת־אֲר֤וֹן הָאֱלֹהִים֙ עַל־עֲגָלָ֣ה חֲדָשָׁ֔ה מִבֵּ֖ית אֲבִינָדָ֑ב וְעֻזָּ֣א וְאַחְי֔וֹ נֹהֲגִ֖ים בָּעֲגָלָֽה׃

controles.web: They carried the ark of God on a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.
controles.kjv: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.
controles.livre: E levaram a arca de Deus da casa de Abinadabe sobre uma carruagem nova, e Uzá e seu irmão guiavam o carro.

versos.hebraico: וְדָוִ֣יד וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מְשַׂחֲקִ֛ים לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּכָל־עֹ֑ז וּבְשִׁירִ֤ים וּבְכִנֹּרוֹת֙ וּבִנְבָלִ֣ים וּבְתֻפִּ֔ים וּבִמְצִלְתַּ֖יִם וּבַחֲצֹצְרֽוֹת׃

controles.web: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, and with harps, and with stringed instruments, and with tambourines, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
controles.kjv: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
controles.livre: E Davi e todo Israel celebravam diante de Deus com toda força; e com canções, harpas, saltérios, tamboris, címbalos e com trombetas.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד־גֹּ֣רֶן כִּידֹ֑ן וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח עֻזָּ֜א אֶת־יָד֗וֹ לֶאֱחֹז֙ אֶת־הָ֣אָר֔וֹן כִּ֥י שָֽׁמְט֖וּ הַבָּקָֽר׃

controles.web: When they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
controles.kjv: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
controles.livre: E quando chegaram à eira de Quidom, Uzá estendeu sua mão para segurar a arca, pois os bois tropeçaram.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּעֻזָּ֔א וַיַּכֵּ֕הוּ עַ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֥ח יָד֖וֹ עַל־הָאָר֑וֹן וַיָּ֥מָת שָׁ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: Yahweh’s anger was kindled against Uzza, and he struck him, because he put out his hand to the ark; and there he died before God.
controles.kjv: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.
controles.livre: Então a ira do SENHOR se acendeu contra Uzá, e o feriu, por ele ter estendido sua mão à arca; e morreu ali diante de Deus.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֣חַר לְדָוִ֔יד כִּֽי־פָרַ֧ץ יְהוָ֛ה פֶּ֖רֶץ בְּעֻזָּ֑א וַיִּקְרָ֞א לַמָּק֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ פֶּ֣רֶץ עֻזָּ֔א עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

controles.web: David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.
controles.kjv: And David was displeased, because the Lord had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez–uzza to this day.
controles.livre: E Davi teve desgosto, porque o SENHOR havia atingido  Uzá; por isso ele chamou aquele lugar Perez-Uzá, até hoje.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּירָ֤א דָוִיד֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵ֚יךְ אָבִ֣יא אֵלַ֔י אֵ֖ת אֲר֥וֹן הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?”
controles.kjv: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?
controles.livre: E Davi temeu a Deus naquele dia, dizendo: Como trarei a mim a arca de Deus?

versos.hebraico: וְלֹֽא־הֵסִ֨יר דָּוִ֧יד אֶת־הָאָר֛וֹן אֵלָ֖יו אֶל־עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד וַיַּטֵּ֕הוּ אֶל־בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד־אֱדֹ֖ם הַגִּתִּֽי׃

controles.web: So David didn’t move the ark to him into the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
controles.kjv: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed–edom the Gittite.
controles.livre: Por isso Davi não trouxe a arca a si, à cidade de Davi; em vez disso ele a trouxe à casa de Obede-Edom, o geteu.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּשֶׁב֩ אֲר֨וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים עִם־בֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם בְּבֵית֖וֹ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד־אֱדֹ֖ם וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: The ark of God remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months: and Yahweh blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that he had.
controles.kjv: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed–edom in his house three months. And the Lord blessed the house of Obed–edom, and all that he had.
controles.livre: Assim a arca de Deus ficou na casa de Obede-Edom, em sua casa, por três meses; e o SENHOR abençoou a casa de Obede-Edom, e tudo quanto ele tinha.
